name: Goethe-Zertifikat A1: Start Deutsch 1
cost_eur: Not published centrally. Each Goethe-Institut or licensed exam centre sets its own fee.
scoring_en: Hören, Lesen and Schreiben give 15 raw points each (45). Sprechen gives 15 raw points. The written raw total is multiplied by 1.66 to give 75 and the speaking raw total by 1.66 to give 25. The exam is passed with at least 60 of 100 points (60 percent) when all four parts were taken. With fewer than 35 written points the exam can no longer be passed. Not modular.

sections.name: Hören
task_types_en: Short everyday dialogues, choose the correct picture or statement
Public announcements, true or false
Telephone messages and recorded information, choose the correct option
sections.note: Duration given as circa 20 minutes. 1 point per item, 15 points maximum.

sections.name: Lesen
task_types_en: Two short texts such as emails, true or false
Small ads or notices, choose the one that fits the situation
Signs and notices, true or false

sections.name: Schreiben
task_types_en: Fill in five fields of a form for another person, 5 points
Write a short personal message or email covering three given points, 10 points, rated by two graders and averaged

sections.name: Sprechen
task_types_en: Introduce yourself using given keywords, 3 points
Ask for and give information on a topic using word cards, 6 points
Make and respond to requests using picture cards, 6 points
sections.note: Group exam with up to four candidates, 15 minutes, each part about 5 minutes, no preparation time.

name: Goethe-Zertifikat A2
cost_eur: Not published centrally. Each Goethe-Institut or licensed exam centre sets its own fee.
scoring_en: Lesen, Hören and Schreiben have 20 raw points each, multiplied by 1.25 to give 25 points each (75 written). Sprechen gives 25 points. The exam is passed with at least 60 of 100 points (60 percent), of which at least 45 in the written part and at least 15 in speaking. Not modular.

sections.name: Hören
sections.note: Duration given as circa 30 minutes.

sections.name: Schreiben
sections.note: 20 raw points rated by two graders, third rating when the average falls under 12 raw points and the graders disagree on passing.

sections.name: Sprechen
task_types_en: Ask and answer four questions from keyword cards, about 3 minutes
Talk about yourself from keyword cards, about 3 minutes per candidate
Plan something together from task cards, about 5 minutes
sections.note: Pair exam 15 minutes, single exam 10 minutes, no preparation time. Introductory exchange is not scored.

source_note: Durchführungsbestimmungen for Goethe-Zertifikat A2 and A2 Fit in Deutsch, Stand 1 September 2025, sections 1.4, 3, 4, 5 and 6.

name: Goethe-Zertifikat B1
cost_eur: Not published centrally. Each Goethe-Institut or licensed exam centre sets its own fee, per module or for all four.
scoring_en: Modular. Each module scores 100 points and is passed on its own with at least 60 points (60 percent). Modules can be taken and repeated separately. Lesen and Hören have 30 items each, raw points multiplied by 3.33 and rounded. Schreiben and Sprechen are rated by two graders and averaged.

sections.name: Hören
sections.note: Duration given as circa 40 minutes.

sections.name: Sprechen
task_types_en: Plan something together, about 2 to 3 minutes
Give a presentation on a chosen topic, about 3 to 4 minutes per candidate
Respond to the partner's presentation, about 1 to 2 minutes per candidate
sections.note: Pair exam circa 15 minutes, single exam circa 10 minutes, 15 minutes preparation.

name: Goethe-Zertifikat B2
cost_eur: Not published centrally. Each Goethe-Institut or licensed exam centre sets its own fee, per module or for all four.
scoring_en: Modular. Each module scores 100 points and is passed on its own with at least 60 points (60 percent). Lesen and Hören have 30 items each, raw points multiplied by 3.33 and rounded. Schreiben and Sprechen are rated by two graders and averaged.

sections.name: Hören
sections.note: Duration given as circa 40 minutes.

sections.name: Sprechen
task_types_en: Short presentation on a chosen topic, about 4 minutes per candidate
Discussion with the partner
sections.note: Pair exam circa 15 minutes, single exam circa 10 minutes, 15 minutes preparation.

name: Goethe-Zertifikat C1
cost_eur: Not published centrally. Each Goethe-Institut or licensed exam centre sets its own fee, per module or for all four.
scoring_en: Modular format in force since 2024. Each module scores 100 points and is passed on its own with at least 60 points (60 percent). Lesen and Hören have 30 items each, raw points multiplied by 3.33 and rounded. Schreiben and Sprechen are rated by two graders and averaged.

sections.name: Hören
sections.note: Duration given as circa 40 minutes.

sections.name: Sprechen
task_types_en: Presentation on a chosen topic with follow up questions, about 7 minutes per candidate
Discussion with the partner, about 5 minutes
sections.note: Pair exam circa 20 minutes, single exam circa 15 minutes, 20 minutes preparation for both.

name: Goethe-Zertifikat C2: Großes Deutsches Sprachdiplom
cost_eur: Not published centrally. Each Goethe-Institut or licensed exam centre sets its own fee, per module or for all four.
scoring_en: Modular. Each module scores 100 points and is passed on its own with at least 60 points (60 percent). Lesen and Hören give 1 point per answer. Schreiben: task 1 has 10 answers at 2, 1 or 0 points (20), task 2 is rated on five criteria at 4 to 0 points (20) and multiplied by four (80). Sprechen: points of both parts are added and multiplied by 2.5, two examiners averaged.

sections.name: Lesen
sections.note: Item count is not stated in the Durchführungsbestimmungen; 1 point per answer, 100 maximum.

sections.name: Hören
sections.note: Duration given as circa 35 minutes. Item count is not stated in the Durchführungsbestimmungen; 1 point per answer, 100 maximum.

sections.name: Schreiben
task_types_en: Rewrite ten sentences or passages, 2 points each, 20 points
Essay on a chosen topic, five criteria, 80 points

sections.name: Sprechen
task_types_en: Production: presentation, about 5 minutes, then questions for about 2 to 3 minutes
Interaction: discussion with the examiner, about 5 minutes
sections.note: Single exam, circa 15 minutes, 15 minutes preparation. Introductory exchange is not scored.

name: telc Deutsch B1 (Zertifikat Deutsch)
cost_eur: Not published centrally. Each telc exam centre sets its own fee.
scoring_en: 300 points: written part 225 (Leseverstehen 75, Sprachbausteine 30, Hörverstehen 75, Schriftlicher Ausdruck 45), oral part 75. Passed with at least 180 points (60 percent) and at least 60 percent in each part, that is 135 of 225 written and 45 of 75 oral. Not modular, but a failed written or oral part can be repeated on its own within the calendar year of the exam or the following one.

sections.name: Leseverstehen
task_types_en: Global understanding, 5 matching items
Detailed understanding, 5 multiple choice items
Selective understanding, 10 matching items
sections.note: The 90 minutes are one block shared with Sprachbausteine.

sections.name: Sprachbausteine
task_types_en: Grammar, 10 multiple choice gaps
Vocabulary, 10 matching gaps
sections.note: Same 90 minute block as Leseverstehen, count it once.

sections.name: Hörverstehen
task_types_en: Global understanding, 5 true or false items
Detailed understanding, 10 true or false items
Selective understanding, 5 true or false items
sections.note: Duration given as circa 30 minutes.

sections.name: Schriftlicher Ausdruck
task_types_en: Informal or semi formal email answering four given points

sections.name: Mündlicher Ausdruck
task_types_en: Getting to know each other, 15 points
Talking about a topic, 30 points
Planning something together, 30 points
sections.note: Pair exam, circa 15 minutes, 20 minutes preparation.

source_note: Übungstest 1, Testformat table page 5 and Punkte und Gewichtung page 39, confirmed against the telc product page.

name: Deutsch-Test für Zuwanderer A2 bis B1
provider: BAMF, developed by g.a.s.t. and Goethe-Institut
cost_eur: Free for funded integration course participants (BAMF pays the fee). External candidates pay a centre fee that BAMF does not publish.
scoring_en: No points total. Hören and Lesen are pooled into 45 items: 20 of 45 correct gives A2, 33 of 45 (pass_mark here) gives B1. Schreiben and Sprechen are each rated A2 or B1 by two raters against criteria. Overall result B1 when Sprechen is B1 and at least one of Hören plus Lesen or Schreiben is B1; otherwise A2 when reached; below A2 only a results notice. Not modular, one sitting.

sections.name: Hören
task_types_en: Telephone and public announcements, 4 items
Radio information, 5 items
Conversations, 8 items
Opinion statements, 3 items

sections.name: Lesen
task_types_en: Catalogues, registers, directories, 5 items
Advertisements, 5 items
Press and formal notices, 6 items
Information brochures, 3 items
Formal letter, 6 items

sections.name: Schreiben
task_types_en: Short letter or message in formal register
sections.note: Rated A2 or B1 by criteria, no point score.

sections.name: Sprechen
task_types_en: 1a introduce yourself, 1b answer follow up questions
2a give information from a picture or topic, 2b compare, narrate, report
3 negotiate something together
sections.note: Pair exam, circa 10 minutes per candidate in the handbook, about 15 minutes for the pair on the BAMF page. Rated A2 or B1 by criteria, no point score.

source_note: Prüfungshandbuch chapter 1 Kurzbeschreibung der Prüfung, table Prüfungsteile und Dauer and the Ergebnisse paragraph. Level is set to B1 because that is the certificate's top result; the same sitting also yields A2.
